lines.text: Many learners say: Do you like tea? Yes, I like.
Better: Do you like tea? Yes, I do.

data.wrong: Do you like tea? Yes, I like.
data.right: Do you like tea? Yes, I do.

quiz.stem: Do you like tea? Yes, I ___.

native.tip: نجيب بـ do عن أسئلة do: “Do you like tea? Yes, I do.” وليس “Do you like tea? Yes, I like.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “Do you like tea? Yes, I like.” 😅 نجيب بـ do عن أسئلة do، فالجملة الصحيحة “Do you like tea? Yes, I do.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “Do you like tea? Yes, I like”?
en.tip: We answer do-questions with do: “Do you like tea? Yes, I do.” not “Do you like tea? Yes, I like.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “Do you like tea? Yes, I like.” 😅 We answer do-questions with do, so the right sentence is “Do you like tea? Yes, I do.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
